decision.reason: [ev-38775be62b3e] says only that support was added for configuring certificate details when the XFCC header is populated. It does not name the setting that controls this, such as a mesh config field, resource field, proxy setting or feature flag. It also gives no default and does not say which components or traffic it affects. Without that, the open applicability aspect cannot be written as a condition that can be evaluated. The upstream PR (#53337) or reference docs naming the configuration field are needed.
